srList.sentence: 2.1 Inclusion and exclusion criteria Inclusion criteria: (1) burn patients who met the indications for VSD treatment and underwent elective wound debridement + first VSD treatment (2) single wound type and wound location (3) no serious organic damage to important organs on admission (4) VSD treatment for 5 to 7 days (5) none tendon injury or fracture (6) wound depth was second or third degree, of which third degree burn area less than 10 total body surface area (TBSA) or total burn area less than 30 TBSA (7) with well compliance and normal spirit (8) signed informed consent.
